title: 大阪杯の後に・太陽、揺るがず

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober has emerged victorious in the battle between queens today! Congratulations once again to Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I was so absorbed in the race that I'm not even sure of how I ran…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (But I won! I beat Air Groove… I've finally reached my ide—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …What a disappointing loss. However, I cannot waste time wallowing in regret.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must never forget this feeling… but I must move forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I won't let things end here. I shall not rest until I've reclaimed my honor as Empress!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (…My legs are starting to shake.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Just being exposed to Air Groove's overwhelming spirit is making me tremble…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: How can I say I've reached my ideal self when I can't even remember how I ran during the race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even if I ran again, I can't guarantee I'd be able to seize the lead without any risk of being overtaken…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This is no good…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to accomplish anything at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I must become like Air Groove! I can't build a new legacy if I don't!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… I have to do something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober makes her declaration the moment she returns to the waiting room, her expression filled with desperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I realized something chasing after Air Groove. The distance between the two of us is still too great.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But this isn't the time to be getting depressed. I'm not the same person I was after the Arima Kinen. I'm going to keep fighting this battle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No doubt Air Groove will be running in the spring Grand Prix—the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And if that's the case, then I'm running in it too! I have to face off against her again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to figure out what's preventing me from becoming like her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's that feeling again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That same strange sense of unease I've experienced before rattles loudly in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My lips part, and before I know it, a question spills forth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no point asking her such a thing when I myself can't put what I'm feeling into words yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to think this through and find an answer… Only then can I talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …You're so weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, our next goal is decided—she'll be running in the Takarazuka Kinen.
